description: Sri Lanka Customs - Rates of Exchange effective from 04.12.2017 to 10.12.2017
reasoning: This gazette notification is issued under the Customs Ordinance (Chapter 235) and establishes new rates of exchange for customs duties and charges. It represents a regulatory framework for customs operations, specifically determining how customs valuations and payments should be calculated. The content involves legal/regulatory matters rather than government personnel changes, organizational structure, or any of the other specialized categories.
